lede: The County is moving to ratify an income-eligibility change at Pinion Park — adjusting the threshold to 80% AMI — which quietly shifts who can qualify for a deed-restricted unit in this valley, and that's worth paying attention to on Wednesday. Also Wednesday, the Town's Ecology Commission takes up a draft ordinance that would ban combustion-powered lawn and garden equipment within Town limits, starting with leaf blowers in 2028. The Housing Authority subcommittee revisits the Martin exception request for a deed-restricted unit roof replacement, and the Film Festival opens Friday at the Sheridan.

notable.stake: County vote on Pinion Park income eligibility shift to 80% AMI affects who qualifies.
Draft ordinance would ban gas-powered lawn equipment in Town limits by 2030.
Board decides on deed-restricted homeowner's $47K roof replacement exception request.
Land Use Code definition changes shaped here before any public hearing process begins.
